note: v0.14.8：诺诺聊天框全新升级——「竹影窗棂」中式视觉（黛青底/朱砂/水青气泡/金色窗格纹），聊天面板不再撑满屏幕（独立滚动+高度上限），按住说话录音中红脉动，消息自动滚底；修复聊天语音无法发送的问题。
noteEn: v0.14.8: Nono chat box fully redesigned — 'Bamboo & Lattice' Chinese visual theme (ink-teal base, cinnabar/celadon bubbles, gold lattice texture). Chat panel no longer fills the screen (independent scrolling with height cap); hold-to-speak pulses red while recording; messages auto-scroll; fixed an issue where voice messages in chat could not be sent.
